message: I remember this one time when a surprise blackout hit while I was in the middle of my favorite TV show. I scrambled around looking for a flashlight, only to find it had mysteriously vanished — probably hiding in some drawer of chaos. I ended up using my phone’s flashlight to navigate through the kitchen, but it was a bit like trying to find my way in a horror movie! It made me realize how handy it is to have a few reliable sources of light on hand, just in case the power decides to play hide and seek. Have you ever had a funny moment during a power outage?
